content: Aḍfar n uřaɣi n Arebbi
S uyenni, a aytma, farḥem di Siditneɣ. War xafi yewɛar ad awem ariɣ timesřayin-a twařa nneɣnit, minzi ad zzaysent tᵉttwaḥḍam.
Ḥḍam ixef nwem zeg yiṭan, ḥḍam zeg ixeddamen iɛeffanen, ḥḍam zeg inni iqeṭṭɛen aysum.
Minzi neccin d axtan, neccin inni ittsexxaren i AREBBI s Arruḥ, inni issemɣaran di Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, uca war ttiqqen ca deg wextan n weysum n bnadem.
Necc zemmareɣ ad ttiqqeɣ deg weysum inu, minzi mařa ittɣiř i ḥed ad ittiqq deg weysum nnes, necc ktar:
aqa ayi d amextan zeg wami ɣari tmenya n wussan, zi řgens n Israil, zeg ayt n Binyamin, necc d Aɛibrani zeg Iɛibraniyyen, zi jjihet n Ccariɛa necc d Afarisi,
zeg uɣezdis n cḍaret tuɣa darrceɣ x tmesmunt n Lmasiḥ, zeg uɣezdis n tsegda tenni di Ccariɛa aqa ayi břa řɛib.
Maca min tuɣa ɣari arbeḥ, aqa ggiɣ t d taxessart x ssibbet n Lmasiḥ.
Necc ggiɣ marra man aya d taxessart zi ssibbet n tussna n Sidi Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, wenni di ṭṭweɛ nnes xsareɣ kuřci, ggiɣ t amecnaw wefraḍ yurṣuḍen ḥima ad arebḥeɣ Lmasiḥ,
maḥend ad ttwafeɣ dayes, war iǧi s tsegda n ixef inu tenni zi Ccariɛa - maca ak-d tenni dd-itteffɣen zi l’iman n Lmasiḥ, aqa-tt d tasegda tenni zi AREBBI -
ḥima ammu i ɣa ssneɣ Yasuɛ d jjehd n tnukra nnes, u maḥend ad carceɣ deg uweddeb nnes, ad dewřeɣ deg warwas n řmewt nnes,
ḥima s ca n webrid ad awḍeɣ ɣar tnukra zi taddart n imettinen.
Necc war ttiwiḍeɣ niɣ ttwakemmřeɣ ɛad, maca yemmareɣ i man aya, ḥima, mařa iɛeddeř, ad ṭṭfeɣ min xef i d ayi iṭṭef Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
A aytma, war d ayi ittɣiř aqa ṭṭfeɣ t, maca tteggeɣ ict n řḥajjet: ttuɣ min awarni ayi uca ad sswiẓẓḍeɣ ixef inu ɣar min din zzati.
Ttizzareɣ ɣar lɣaraḍ ḥima ad ṭṭfeɣ ttaj n uɣelleb n třaɣit yuɛřan n AREBBI tenni iǧan di Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Ejj inni iwḍen ɣar řekmaret, ad rekkzen xenni di tmesřayin-a. Uca mařa ɣarwem nneyyet nneɣni di ca, aqa AREBBI ad awem isscen man aya ɛawed.
Maca ejj aneɣ, ḥima ad naweḍ ɣar man aya, ad nuyur deg webrid d ijjen s ixariṣṣen nneɣ d ijjen.
Ḍfarem ayi-dd, a aytma, ksim tiweṣṣaf i inni yuyuren ɛlaḥsab amedya i zzayneɣ teẓrim.
Minzi aqa din aṭṭas inni yuyuren war iǧi amenni, nniɣ awem tt aṭṭas n imuren - uca řexxu ad tt iniɣ s imeṭṭawen - aqa aten d řɛedyan n ṣṣalib n Lmasiḥ.
Aneggaru nsen d ahellek, arebbi nsen d aɛeddis nsen uca aɛuǧi nsen d abehdeř nsen, u nneyyet nsen di tmesřayin n ddunect.
Maca neccin nᵉttsexxar deg ijenwan i zzayes nettraja ɛawed wenni d aneɣ itticen Tudart, Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ,
wenni i ɣa ibeddřen arrimet nneɣ iḥebḍen, ḥima ad tedweř di ṣṣifet n Arrimet nnes iɛuǧen, ɛlaḥsab jjehd nnes tameqqrant i zi i ɣa ittwagg marra min iǧan swadday Nnes.
